items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: We recorded the song in Universal Studios with Lee Gillette A&R and the record sound beautiful.

ctx.x: The rest of it was raised in the sand.

Yeah, the rest of it was raised in the sand. And it was just too pretty and it just wasn't the timing. It was the wrong time for it to come out. And the, I had worked with Lou Douglas for a while. Lou Douglas liked a lot of them. I had about, written about 20 songs by then. So, he came to my house one day and I, he went over the first five and said, I like all these five. Let me have them see what I can do. So, Tommy Leonetti came to town and he submitted one to Leonetti. And so Lou and Leonetti thought it was…
It's too bad you couldn't have simply changed the title and used the same one.
